profile.summary: Berjaya Property Berhad engages in the gaming and lottery management business in Malaysia and internationally. It operates through Toto Betting and Related Activities; Motor Vehicle Dealership; Property Development and Property Investment; Hotels and Resorts; and Club, Recreation and Others segments. It engages in betting operations; leasing of online lottery equipment; manufacturing and distribution of computerised wagering and voting systems; motor vehicle retail; repairs, maintenance, and providing of related aftersales services; development of residential and commercial properties; operation and letting of properties; management and operations of hotels, resorts, and casino; and operations of recreational clubs vacation time-share and air charter. It also engages in the provision of landscaping services; selling and renting of ornament plants; recruitment of workers; building contractors, civil engineering, and public works; security services; operation of golf; jet charter services; aircraft leasing; offshore financial related business; project management; construction of railways and subways; and trading of goods. In addition, it provides passenger charter flights, computer consultancy, software license and support, sanitary landfill and environmental, aviation, management services, booking centre, food and beverage; accommodation; interior design and consultancy services for land and building development projects; and river cleaning services. Further, it is involved in investment and rental of properties; sale, purchase, leasing, and management of real estate; airport, road and other infrastructure development; construction of bunds and river banks; and investment in solar photovoltaic systems, and operates as an insurance and marketing agent. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The company was formerly known as Berjaya Land Berhad. Berjaya Property Berhad operates as a subsidiary of Berjaya Corporation Berhad.
profile.zh: Berjaya Property Berhad 于1990年成立，总部位于马来西亚吉隆坡，是 Berjaya Corporation Berhad 的子公司，原名 Berjaya Land Berhad。公司在马来西亚及国际范围内经营游戏与彩票管理、汽车经销、房地产开发与投资、酒店度假村等多元业务。
lines: 彩票投注及相关活动：经营投注业务、租赁在线彩票设备、制造和分销计算机化投注和投票系统。
汽车经销：零售汽车、维修保养及提供相关售后服务。
房地产开发与投资：开发住宅和商业物业、运营和租赁物业。
酒店及度假村：管理和运营酒店、度假村及赌场。
俱乐部、休闲及其他：运营休闲俱乐部、度假分时共享和空中包机，并提供景观、招聘、建筑、安保、高尔夫、飞机租赁、项目管理、铁路和地铁建设、商品贸易、客运包机、计算机咨询、软件许可和支持、卫生填埋和环境服务、航空服务、管理服务、预订中心、餐饮、住宿、室内设计咨询、河流清洁、房地产投资租赁、机场和道路等基础设施开发、太阳能光伏系统投资以及保险和营销代理等服务。
lines_en: Toto Betting and Related Activities: Engages in betting operations, leasing of online lottery equipment, and manufacturing and distribution of computerised wagering and voting systems.
Motor Vehicle Dealership: Retails motor vehicles, repairs, maintenance, and provides related aftersales services.
Property Development and Property Investment: Develops residential and commercial properties, and operates and lets properties.
Hotels and Resorts: Manages and operates hotels, resorts, and casino.

Club, Recreation and Others: Operates recreational clubs, vacation time-share, and air charter; also provides landscaping, recruitment, building contractors, civil engineering, security, golf, jet charter, aircraft leasing, offshore financial, project management, railway and subway construction, trading of goods, passenger charter flights, computer consultancy, software license and support, sanitary landfill and environmental, aviation, management services, booking centre, food and beverage, accommodation, interior design and consultancy, river cleaning, investment and rental of properties, real estate sale/purchase/leasing/management, airport/road/infrastructure development, construction of bunds and river banks, investment in solar photovoltaic systems, and insurance and marketing agent services.
